title: UI critique (Low): verify native search collapse-on-blur flicker
description: Candidate by agent-463d via DISCOVERIES: WebKit does not focus buttons on click, so clicking the Projects magnifier while the search field is open and empty may collapse on blur then reopen on click (flicker). Not reproducible in the browser build; only a native check can confirm or dismiss. Suggested: check in the smoke build; if it flickers, collapse only on Escape or outside click.
